quest.title: The Final Chapter
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Stories of You and the Aranara x1

dialogues.text: #Golden Nara... Yep, that's right, Nara {NICKNAME}, and the Floaty, White Floaty.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Hello, Aranaga, I am! Been waiting here for a long time, I have!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've also been looking for you for a long time, little bean!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Aranaga, I am. Little bean, I am not. Soft-Fluffy White-Mushroom Floaty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Soft and fluffy... white mushroom? What? Are you talking about Paimon?

choices.text: Paimon's silhouette does resemble a mushroom.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, it does not!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon is Paimon, hello!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Aramango, what can we do for you?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: #It's Aranaga. My friends, Nara {NICKNAME} must have met. They are the ones who led you here, correct?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, we met your two little friends! They said we could meet you here.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Welcome to the Mawtiyima Forest, my garden, this is. Many flora friends, mushroom friends here. Here, they love.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Because is here, Mawtiyima. Protects us, protects the forest, Mawtiyima. So can gather with friends, help friends thrive, Aranaga.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: #But need help, we. Can give help, Nara {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... What do you want us to help with?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: #Yes, yes, correct you are, Nara {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Turning into a dull color, Mawtiyima is very sad... But you guys can definitely help, she said. So I waited for you here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Morty... mi-amore... momma-mia? Argh! However you pronounce it! What is it?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: It's what Nara Varuna left behind, gathering the Elements and nutrients to feed the forest, Mawtiyima.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: "...During the first moon, made the Fungi came to life, Mawtiyima. During the second moon, the branches woke up."

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: "On the ground, the moon cast shadows, shadows of the chattering leaves..."

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: "During the third moon, startled lazy flowers from sleep, Mawtiyima. They blossomed one by one, lively and rambunctious," said the long-lived trees...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: But after many, many more moons, Marana came out of the moons' shadows and devoured Mawtiyima.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: They came too, the walking Shroom-Kin, not afraid of Marana, but very frightening.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Paimon is getting more and more confused...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Because White Floaty is silly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, why are all of you like this!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Oh, you should have the Kusava already.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Don't eat it. Is for waking mushrooms and vines, the Kusava.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: When mushrooms and vines wake up, they will carry everyone higher so that you can find the Yajna Grass!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yammering Grass? What's that?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: It's "Yajna," destinated to turn into Arahaoma. Very cute and pitiful.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Over there, its home is. I point it to you, I take you to see.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, find it and then what do we do?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Make it and its other two friends into Arahaoma, then open the... pass?... puzz?... of vines that leads to Mawtiyima... Use Arahaoma.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean "path"?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Yes, Nara call a flat stripe with no grass a "path." Nara don't like plants. Aranara like plants. But the meanings, same.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Only this way will Marana recede, Mawtiyima said. Everyone is also urging me, flowers and trees.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Golden Nara, very much like Nara Varuna. Save the forest, save us, must be... should be able to.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For some reason that last pause really annoys Paimon...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Aranara trust you, so please trust Aranaga as well. Let Aranaga bring you there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, by the looks of your eagerness, it seems like something very serious.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Serious, yes. Be ahead of the moon, not behind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's this about behind the moon now...?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: I'll take you to the Yajna Grass.

choices.text: We have to pick up the pace.
Little bean is right. Paimon is indeed soft and fluffy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's weird to hear you say that!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: It's not little bean, it's Aranaga. Golden melon Nara is doofus Nara, likes to be bad.

talks.objective: Go with Aranaga to look for the Yajna Grass

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Here it is! The Yajna Grass! It's protected, the Yajna Grass!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Unseal it, and then we can talk to the Yajna Grass!

talks.objective: Use the Kusava to break the seal on the Yajna Grass
Use the Kusava to break the seal on the Yajna Grass
Use the Kusava to break the seal on the Yajna Grass

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I am ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon too!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: So... Aranakin, Aragaru, let's start the ritual.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Come, come, dreams of the garden, memories of the forest..."\n"Come, come, wind that doesn't return, water that doesn't flow backwards..."\n"Come, come, sweet dreams and bitter aftertastes."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Farewell, let us say:"\n"Old leaves, swollen fruit..."\n"Drifted dreams, fallen flowers."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Wait, let us."\n"Season of rain returns, plants rejoice..."\n"The pomegranate sings, the apples clap."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Yajna Grass is right here!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Excuse me, please. Let me say a few words, with the Yajna Grass.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Though it's the garden of Aranaga, there is only one Yajna Grass here...

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: There were many, once. Whenever the moon rose or fell, a Yajna Grass would grow...

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: But it came, Marana. In the wake of Marana, walking Shroom-Kin came. They ate and ate. Died, many Yajna Grass, leaving just this one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then what are you guys gonna do after we use the Yammering Grass to make Arahaoma?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: It's the Yajna Grass, White Mushroom silly. But no need to worry. The important seeds are kept safe by Jamikayomars. The gate of Mawtiyima, Jamikayomars is guarding.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon sees...

choices.text: Doesn't Aranaga still need to catch up on the old times, with the Yajna Grass...?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Aranaga whispers to the plant for a while...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Willing to become Arahaoma, he said.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: And... Thank you.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Next, let's go to Jamikayomars, together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then lead the way, little bean!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Little bean, not! Aranaga! Floaty is mean!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, Paimon is not mean!

choices.text: There's no time to lose. Let's take the Yajna Grass away.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Over here, Jamikayomars is!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Nara Varuna's memory cup grows here, so the name is Jamikayomars. Jamikayomars is guarding Mawtiyima, so cannot enter, those bad guys.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... Where, the Marana you spoke of is?

choices.text: Yes, anything unusual, we haven't seen...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Talking like this? Since when did you start...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Mawtiyima has been infiltrated by Marana. So we must infuse Arahaoma into Jamikayomars.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: He will open the path for us, once Jamikayomars remembers it all, then we go in and rescue Mawtiyima.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What is it, Arahaoma?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: The essence of memory, messenger that drives away death, the elixir Arahaoma is. Carries our memories, carries our life, the elixir Arahaoma.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: To make Arahaoma, three types of plants are required: Yajna Grass and its friends, Barsam Flower and Zohrah Mushroom.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Under the moonlight, with the precious memories, refine them, so that the potion can be complete.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: After Arahaoma is offered, Jamikayomars will awaken, then our memory will flow out, flow into the forest.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Mawtiyima, will be saved.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About the memory...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Nara language, I don't know how to use. Memory, dead, frozen, many Nara believe. Memory will be lost, many Nara believe.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: But it is alive, flowing, not lost... It needs to be nourished.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: There are dreams because there is memory. Memory is nourished, so there is life.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: So, it can grow, the thing to repel Marana.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Oh, what's that Nara word... I'm stuck. Don't know how to say it.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Yes, that's right. Seeds must be sturdy to withstand Marana. Only seeds with hard shells will not let Marana penetrate their soft cores. Only seeds with thorns will prick Marana.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: But first, we must have Arahaoma to awake Jamikayomars. And to make Arahaoma, we need the Barsam Flower and the Zohrah Mushroom.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: They have already been gathered.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, exactly the same as Nara Varuna... And golden too. Thank you.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Please come back when the moon rises over the tallest tree. The ritual to obtain Arahaoma will begin then.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: #Yeah, right you are, Golden Nara {NICKNAME}. The thing that flows, cannot be seen, cannot be touched... Hope. Like the wind... But it never dissipates, like a dream.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Wisdom... Flowing memory, wisdom. Stagnant wisdom, Marana's lair. So, living memory gives birth to living wisdom, and dead Marana will dissipate. Nara Varuna said... that the dead cannot defeat the living.

choices.text: Talking in this way as well, Paimon is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! That's none of your business!

talks.objective: Wait until the moon hangs high in the sky (23:00 – 01:00)

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: There you are! Welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: But the moon's not there yet... Would you wait a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Look, the potion is ready...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Finished, we are! Is here, Arahaoma!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Please take good care of her. Next, we will go offer the potion to Jamikayomars.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Please take good care of her! Save our dream garden together, Mawtiyima's dream.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Yep! Aragaru wants to say the same!

talks.objective: Go to Jamikayomars and offer the elixir
Go to Jamikayomars and offer the elixir

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: #This is the place, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Please offer Arahaoma, over here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Offer Arahaoma)

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Look! Has accepted you, Jamikayomars.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa! What's going on!? {NICKNAME}, be careful! Are you okay?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Okay, next... Um...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Enter the Morty Arena! ...Right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How do you actually remember this name!?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Yes... Yes, go in. Fight Marana, together let us.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: New life, memory nourishes. Death is just a one-time loss of memory.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: So... our sacrifice, please witness, please keep it in your memories and dreams.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Okay, don't keep Mawtiyima waiting too long! Everyone's worried...

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Yeah! Let's go and defeat Marana together!

choices.text: Let's talk about this when we've solved the problem.
Well, we just have to go in, right...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah...

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: The essence of memories, the powers of the Kusava... Only with these can we defeat Marana.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Yes. Let's use the Kusava right now!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Kusava!

talks.objective: Clean up the pollution caused by The Withering
Clean up the pollution caused by The Withering
Clean up the pollution caused by The Withering
Clean up the pollution caused by The Withering
Go and clear the last Withering Zone

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have other things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Alright, but it won't wait for us, the rising and setting of the moon. So hurry there and back, please do. But... No need to rush. Here, we will wait for you.

talks.objective: Clean up the last Withering Zone

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #Aranaga, {M#he}{F#she}'s here, they're here!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Yea, here, here!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: #Here you are, Nara {NICKNAME}, White Floaty. Welcome you, the three of us.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: The Arahaoma ritual is about to begin. What are we waiting for?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, aren't you guys really anxious to hold the... that ritual?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Still wait for a little bit, we can. Grateful, we are. So... as is customary for Nara, precious gifts, we will give you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... gifts? Precious gifts?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Yes, indeed. Gifts! Precious gifts!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Our gifts are the most precious. They have life. Compared to dead things, living things, are more worth protecting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: See, Aranaga said it — the most precious gifts!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: #Helped us, saved the forest, Nara {NICKNAME}. We are grateful, so... I give you, this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh... What is this...?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: It's a living memory, a "remembrance," Nara calls it. Creatures that forget easily, Nara are. So must remember, use things that have life.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Here, Aranaga's remembrance, is this flower. Cannot blow him away, the Ad Oblivione; cannot destroy him, the device that takes away dreams.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Yes, the wind that flows forever, the thousand winds that return to one. But, on earth is the stream, and the ubiquitous is the wind. Everlasting, devastating.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've lost Paimon...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: White Floaty silly, but silly is only for now. White Floaty will know, in future.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: And me! Here's my flower!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: When you leave the forest and go back to the place full of sand, please don't forget us... Like this flower.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We won't forget. You can't forget us either!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's the matter? Are you upset?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: No, no, I'm very happy! We won't forget you all... Even if we do, you will remind us, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: I'll give you my flower, too! Please accept it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, thank you!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: I wanted to give you meaty bugs... But Aranaga said Nara don't like eating those... so I gave you a flower too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's okay, flowers are great!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Is here, the moon. Is here, the moment when the moon is high up in the sky. Are you ready?

choices.text: The thing that takes away dreams...?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: The living memory of nature, dream. Man-made dead thing, mechanism. Taking away living memory, grinding and crushing to extract its juice, like a grinder, for dominion and domestication... Don't like this, Aranara.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh... Why?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Because the garden of freedom, the source of power, dreams and memories, not only for Aranara, but also for Nara. But Nara don't know. Not good action... extraction, grinding.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Memories and dreams are gone, reason for action is gone, strength is also gone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmmm... Paimon doesn't get it...

choices.text: Paimon, it might not be what you think...

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Thank you, Nara... Golden Nara. For all that you've done, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Free of the burden of Marana, Mawtiyima is. She is very happy, Mawtiyima.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we just happened to be passing by so we lent a hand! That Morty Arena should be thanking you guys!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Is that so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm... That's right. What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Nothing, nothing... It's just, before we came here, the things we experienced together now seems like a fog, like clouds. Can't see them clearly... Need to remember.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Is it because you're too tired?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's right. Let's go out together and bask in the sun more, and our heads will be clear!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Thanks, but... still needs our company, Mawtiyima.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Mm, because Mawtiyima just woke up and got a lot of stories to tell us!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Mawtiyima wants to share her dreams with us, so we can't leave yet...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon sees... We've just finished the important business, and Paimon hasn't got the chance to get to know you better...

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: It's okay, we will still be friends as long as we remember you.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: As long as... still remember you, we can.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Yeah! As long as we remember!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Here is a song so you don't forget me. Please remember this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay... We got it!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Then... If I forget you guys, I will remember when I hear this song.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Because... new life, memory nourishes. Death is just a loss of memory.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: So... our sacrifice, please witness, please keep it in your memories and dreams.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Why do you look sad now? Please don't be sad. We're still going to play together at Festival Utsava!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: The memories we described to you, the story we experienced, will definitely remain in dreams!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... though Paimon can't help but feel a bit worried...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: It's okay, Mawtiyima is used to it. The forest and the earth are used to it... In the soil, in the roots, our memories are.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Yes, Marana makes others forget, but we defeated it. Our memories are forever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you guys haven't said if you will forget us...

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Still needs us, Mawtiyima. So... sorry, can't keep her waiting too long.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Yeah, please give us some time. Mawtiyima still needs to talk with us!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Remember to come play with us, Golden Nara and White Floaty!

choices.text: You guys will forget, won't you?
Spend more time in the sun and your head will clear up.

talks.objective: (tes) Reach the location of a seal
(tes) Reach the location of a seal
(tes) Reach the location of a seal

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: You're here! Welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Is here, the moon. Is here, the moment when the moon is high up in the sky. Are you ready?
